verdict.rationale: Mistral publishes a dedicated model-lifecycle doc describing defined stages from release to retirement, explicitly stating the purpose is to let developers plan migrations before a model is retired, and even flags experimental 'Labs' models to set expectations before production commitment. Missing for 10: no explicit stated advance-notice time window (e.g. '90 days notice') or a concrete migration-guide example/case study, and no independent/community corroboration of the policy being honored in practice.
